headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2023: Bryan Danielson vs. Brody King met in a Continental Classic League Match, closing out the card as the main event on Collision, rated 8.30 ? one of the better matches of the year, on an outstanding Winter is Coming '23 - Night 3 show that earned an overall rating of 9.05. Danielson closed out his Continental Classic group stage undefeated with a hard-fought win over the powerhouse Brody King, punching his ticket to the semifinals.
2020 brought us this moment: Max Caster competed under the AEW banner for the first time, appearing on Dynamite, rated 4.67.

secondaries.text: On a Saturday in 2023, back when Bryan Keith arrived in AEW against Orange Cassidy, appearing on Collision, rated 6.70.
